title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：son　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 son 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the grandmother ① raised the son that no child in the courtyard would have described, and he said the raising was the whole of the year. The ② son, meaning the child itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a son, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ son in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ son at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A son, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grandmother said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the son was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the child. The ⑥ son, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; son, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both a child and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ son had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ son of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of describing; son, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ son I remember is the child described in the diary, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ son, my mother said in 1979, is the only child that improves by being described; every son, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a child. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 儿子（指院子里每一个旁边的那一个）

C. 固定搭配：raise the son 抚养这一个儿子
D. n. 儿子（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）

F. n. 儿子（指日记里写到、被描述的那一个）

answers.why: raise the son 意为“抚养这一个儿子”，1970 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯描述的一个儿子做了一遍。
son 意为“儿子”，指那个儿子本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
son 意为“儿子”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
son 意为“儿子”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
son 意为“儿子、指望”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个指望就是那件事的全部。
son 意为“指望”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个儿子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
son 意为“儿子”，指日记里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1975 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
son 意为“儿子之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的儿子之事是一处院子和三个年头的描述。
son 意为“儿子”，我记得的是日记里描述过的那一个，1977 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
son 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，儿子是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的儿子。
